headline.en: Kartesia Asset Finance deploys €88m across three aviation, maritime and logistics deals
headline.zh: Kartesia Asset Finance在航空、海事和物流三笔交易中部署8800万欧元

summary.en: Kartesia Asset Finance completed three investments totalling €88m from its KAF III fund, spanning aviation, maritime and logistics assets in Europe and the US. The deals follow the close of KAF III at €366m, including €50m from the European Investment Fund, and the fund has a target size of €500m. The firm said it aims to deploy between €300m and €400m annually.
summary.zh: Kartesia Asset Finance从其KAF III基金完成了三笔总额8800万欧元的投资，涵盖欧洲和美国的航空、海事及物流资产。这些交易是在KAF III以3.66亿欧元完成募集之后进行的，其中包括来自European Investment Fund的5000万欧元，该基金的目标规模为5亿欧元。该公司表示，其目标是在其资产融资策略中每年部署3亿至4亿欧元。

headline.en: Rithm Capital's Genesis Capital Closes $375M Multifamily Loan Securitization
headline.zh: Rithm Capital 旗下 Genesis Capital 完成 3.75 亿美元多户住宅贷款证券化

summary.en: Rithm Capital announced that its commercial real estate originations subsidiary, Genesis Capital, closed a $375 million securitization of U.S. multifamily loans. The deal, NRMLT 2026-RTL1, is collateralized by a pool of 55 loans and is the first multifamily-only securitization Genesis has closed since Rithm acquired the firm in 2021. Multifamily originations represent 40 percent of Genesis' total origination volume, and rose from $160 million in the first quarter of 2024 to $637 million in the second quarter of 2026.
summary.zh: Rithm Capital 宣布，其商业房地产发起子公司 Genesis Capital 完成了 3.75 亿美元美国多户住宅贷款证券化。该交易名为 NRMLT 2026-RTL1，以 55 笔贷款组合为抵押，是 Rithm 于 2021 年收购该公司以来 Genesis 完成的首笔纯多户住宅证券化。多户住宅贷款发起占 Genesis 总发起量的 40%，并从 2024 年第一季度的 1.6 亿美元增至 2026 年第二季度的 6.37 亿美元。

source.publisher: Commercial Real Estate Financing | Commercial Observer

items.source_headline: Rithm Capital Closes $375M Securitization of Multifamily Loans

reason.zh: 已评估严重程度：有限；关联程度：行业。

items.relevance_reason: A $375 million commercial mortgage-backed securitization of multifamily loans expands real-estate credit issuance, relevant to the mortgage and real-estate sub-sectors even though Rithm is not a tracked manager.
